name: MerchantReservationEnquiryData
description: MerchantReservationEnquiryData schema from Quandoo Public Partner API

id.description: The unique identifier of the reservation enquiry for the calling agent (Agent dependent field) or NULL if the agent identifier should be created. Optional.

merchantId.description: The ID of the merchant at which this reservation will be made.

capacity.description: The capacity (people count) of the reservation enquiry.

startDateTime.description: The start date and time of the potential reservation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

endDateTime.description: The end date and time of the potential reservation. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

id.description: Identifier of the customer for the calling agent. (Agent dependent field)

firstName.description: The first name of the customer. Optional.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the customer.

phoneNumber.description: The phone number of the customer. The expected format is E164 e.g. +4930120765890

locale.description: The locale of the customer. E.g. de_DE

country.description: The 2 letter ISO country of the customer, e.g. DE

subscriptions.description: The requested subscriptions, e.g. QUANDOO, MERCHANT

tracking.description: A tracking string to be stored with the reservation. Optional.

referenceId.description: A reference id to be stored with the reservation. Optional.
